text:
Introduction
This document outlines the 
equipment inspection list I1, to be performed every six months bases as indicated by M6 
in the above title block
The first draft initiated by eng. Ragab Goada 
 Abo-Zeed tested by eng. Emad Abraheem Gooda, accepted by general manager eng. 
 Hassan Saeed Dosoki , approved by eng. Gaber Mohamed Farahat head sector of 
 Damanhour power station and 
 certified by eng. Sania Diab Attia: WDEPC Inspection head 
 sector and MPIS coordinator.

Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued
The maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area is required.
Wear the safety and 
 healthy equipment as safety helmet, shoes, gloves ...etc
Shutdown the pump
Circuit breaker racked out.
Tools and 
Equipment
Complete maintenance tool 
 set
Cleaning fluid rags.
Work to be carried Out
Change the bearing lube oil.
Check mechanical seal for leakage.
General inspection of bolts looseness or any 
 abnormalities.
